title: Mesha Stele
summary: A Moabite inscription describing King Mesha's achievements and conflict with Israel.
historical_context: A major Iron Age West Semitic inscription and an important external witness to Moab and Israel.
ancient_near_east_context: The item belongs to the broader imperial, cultic, and urban world of the ancient Near East and the biblical periods reflected in the dataset.
literary_context: Often discussed alongside the Moabite conflict narrative in Kings.
covenantal_significance: Mesha Stele helps anchor biblical claims in historical reality while reminding readers that archaeology supports rather than replaces interpretation.
interpretive_notes: The stele is genuine, but exact readings of a few damaged areas still draw scholarly discussion.
Use the item as context for the biblical text, not as a shortcut around it.
